title: FindBack Curated Model Library catalogue (v1, spec-only)
description: Shipped/pinned catalogue metadata. The app MUST NOT depend on a mutable remote list (see releases-distribution.md). Unknown values use explicit sentinels, never invented numbers.

tag.description: Immutable release tag this catalogue build is pinned to

sha256OrUnknown.description: 64 lowercase hex chars, or null when not established. VERIFIED entries MUST be non-null.

bytesOrUnknown.description: Exact byte count, or null when not established. VERIFIED entries MUST be non-null.

distribution.description: Pinned GitHub Release asset for the .fbmodel package, or null when not distributed. The runtime builds the download URL from repo/tag/asset only; it never polls the API and never uses latest/main.

repo.description: Curated release repo with owner, e.g. sheikhti1205/FindBack-Models

parts.description: Chunk parts when a single asset would exceed the per-asset limit, else null. v1 small entries use null.

role.description: Short functional role, e.g. report-from-photo, chat-text, catalog-reference

revision.description: Pinned upstream commit/revision, or UNKNOWN_NOT_ESTABLISHED (never invent).

license.description: License identifier as published by the rights holder (e.g. apache-2.0, lfm-open-1.0, gemma).

installedSha256.description: Installed-weights artifact hash; distinct from the distribution-package sha256, which packaging may change by design.

ramRequirementSource.description: Provenance of the min-free-RAM figure (the install gate). MEASURED = on-device measurement with method on file; VENDOR = vendor/model-card/paper figure (stack may differ — see ramNotes); CONSERVATIVE_ESTIMATE = design estimate from the documented formula (see ram-ui.md).

catalogOnly.description: True = listed for reference; NOT distributed via FindBack-Models releases in v1.

requiresAdvancedConfirm.description: True = install/run below minimum free RAM (or any run for catalogOnly large entries) needs explicit advanced confirmation (gate DESIGNED in ram-ui.md, enforcement is a later task).

releaseAsset.description: Pinned asset name(s) in pinnedModelsRelease, or null when catalogOnly / not yet published.

distribution.description: Pinned .fbmodel release asset for this entry, or null when not distributed. Upstream repo/revision/file stay as provenance only.
